column1: # Per-layer line-coverage floors (#1348).
# A floor is a ratchet: the measured line coverage on the date in the last
# column. It exists so a layer cannot regress while the crate-wide number
# stays green — before this, three documented thresholds (domain ≥95,
# application ≥90, interface ≥85) were compared to nothing: the only gate
# was workspace-wide at 60 %.
# The `target` column is the criterion from
# wasm/.pi/architecture/implementation-roadmap.md. Where the measured value is
# below it the gap is printed, so an unmet criterion reads as a gap rather
# than as a threshold something enforces.
# Two half-rules, both executable now:
#   · a floor may not be LOWERED — `.pi/scripts/validate-coverage-floors.sh`
#     compares this file with the base commit and fails naming the layer, the
#     old value and the new one (#1427);
#   · a floor may not be STALE — `coverage.sh --gate-layers` fails when the
#     measured value is above the floor, because a floor below the measurement
#     is a floor nobody raised.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   layer  crate  test-target  ignore-filename-regex  floor  target  measured-on
domain
